issue.body: We have the following scenario ( fastapi + starlette with async functions) - user upload file => our app will load and analyze the file => send to other rest servers for analyze the text => return response to user. - it will take long time for `load and analyze the file`, if we run the logical in caller thread, it will block all other new connections to our server. so have to create thread or just use [starlette.starlette.background.BackgroundTask](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/starlette/background.py#L15). - BUT I found [starlette.BackgroundTask](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/starlette/background.py#L15) can NOT return any data to caller. so I have to write a similar class `BackgroundWithResultTask` just for add "return" # sample caller code ```python task = BackgroundWithResultTask(self.loader_mgr.load_file, file_path) # return task result without block other request, parsed_docs = await task() return await other_rest_request(parsed_docs) ``` # change code(just modify return type and add 2 return) ```python class BackgroundTask: def __init__( self, func: typing.Callable[P, typing.Any], *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs ) -> None: self.func = func self.args = args self.kwargs = kwargs self.is_async = is_async_callable(func) async def __call__(self) -> typing.Any: # return Any if self.is_async: return await self.func(*self.args, **self.kwargs) # add return else: return await run_in_threadpool(self.func, *self.args, **self.kwargs) # add return ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
